findings.title: `workspaces:relocate` row does not mention the new refusal while a group move runs
findings.body: This PR makes "Change folder…" refuse with `moving` while a group move holds the lock. `busyNow()` returns `"moving"` (`main/workspaces/index.ts:66-67`) and is now wired into `activeTransactionDeps` (`index.ts:347`). `relocateRefusal` returns that busy value for any workspace (`relocate.ts:24-25`). The row still says "while a recording or export runs", and the backlog banner (`backlog/several-workspaces.md:26`) repeats it. Add "or a group move" to both so the docs match the code.

findings.title: The new `moving` branch of `relocateRefusalMessage` has no test
findings.body: `relocateRefusalMessage` has no test for any reason, and the dialog test added here covers only `not-a-workspace`. Nothing checks that `moving` maps to `relocateMoving`. `relocate.test.ts` types its `busy` stub as `"recording" | "exporting"` (line 54), so the main-side refusal for a running move is not covered either. A small case for each, with `busy: () => "moving"`, would pin the new lock.

contracts.action: "Change folder…" is refused with `moving` while a group move runs
contracts.equivalent_path: The existing `recording` and `exporting` refusals through `relocateRefusal` and `switchWorkspace`.
contracts.before_after: Before this PR, `busy` was set only on the inner deps passed to `switchWorkspace`, so `activeTransactionDeps()` had no `busy` of its own. Now `busy: busyNow` is on the shared transaction deps, so `relocateFolder` (`index.ts:480-484`) and the late re-check in `relocateActive` (`switch-transaction.ts:105-115`) also see `moving`. The refusal runs before the folder picker opens, and again inside `relocateWorkspace`.
contracts.visible_effect: `relocateRefusalMessage` maps `moving` to `relocateMoving` (`relocate-copy.ts:35-36`). The message exists in en and es (`en.json:2630`, `es.json:2630`), and the `moving` literal is in `WorkspaceRelocateRefusal` (`shared/types/workspaces.ts:158`).
contracts.failure_mode: `busyNow()` is `host?.busy() ?? (moveRun ? "moving" : null)`. When the host returns null, `??` falls through to `moveRun`, so a running move is still reported. Moves and relocates both run on the single main-process event loop. A non-active workspace's relocate takes no gate lock after the early check, but the same gap already exists for `recording`.

thread_replies.reply: Not in this part's diff. The author says fac69179 maps `StaleWorkspaceError` to `stale`, `MaintenanceError` to `maintenance` and anything else to `io`. I did not re-verify that here.
Not in this part's diff. The author says fac69179 clears the cached device-id promise when it rejects. I did not re-verify that here.
The comment on `skipped` in `shared/types/workspaces.ts:252-256` now matches the code. Only Stop fills `skipped`. A group refused as a whole lists every item in `failed` and leaves `skipped` empty.
Not in this part's diff. The author says fac69179 stops `ensureByName` minting at `TAGS_PER_ITEM_MAX`. I did not re-verify that here.
Not in this part's diff. The author says 3639b994 stops the heal from touching `.kaipu/drag/`, and that 670b1ba7 updates ADR 0033 decision 11. I did not re-verify either here.
Not in this part's diff. The author says 3639b994 wraps the post-commit heal and returns the real `mode`. I did not re-verify that here.
Not in this part's diff. The author says 7e503dfa makes the card and row ignore keys whose `e.target !== e.currentTarget`. I did not re-verify that here.
Not in this part's diff. The author says bbe5d284 sends a result with nothing moved and nothing failed down the `resultNone` branch. I did not re-verify that here.
Not in this part's diff. The author says bbe5d284 collects each recording's exports in on-screen order. I did not re-verify that here.
Superseded by the later thread on the same line. Not in this part's diff, and I did not re-verify the fix.

`es.json` in this part uses "espacio de trabajo" in the strings I read, including the new `relocateNotWorkspace` and `relocateMoving`. I did not check `chipLabel`, `newWorkspace` or `reason_stale`, which are outside this part's diff.
Not in this part's diff. The author says 02dbb2ec adds `move.resultUnknown` and no longer builds per-item results for a lost IPC reply. I did not re-verify that here.

structuredOutput.summary: This part is small and consistent. The new `moving` refusal for \"Change folder…\" is wired end to end: the shared type, the lock in `activeTransactionDeps`, the renderer mapping, and the en and es strings. I found no defects. Two notes: the spec's `workspaces:relocate` row and the backlog banner still say only \"recording or export\", and the new `moving` branch has no test. For the earlier threads, I could confirm only the `skipped` comment fix from this part's files. The rest are fixes the author reports in files outside this part, which I did not re-check.
